scripts.build:release: bun run build:web && bun scripts/run-truce-formats.mjs build && bun run build:post:assets
scripts.build:debug: bun run build:web && bun scripts/run-truce-formats.mjs build --debug && bun run build:post:assets
scripts.build:standalone: bun run build:web && WRY_CUSTOM_SCHEME=cosmopd101standalone WRY_OBJC_CLASS_PREFIX=CosmoPd101Standalone cargo truce build --standalone && bun run build:post:assets
scripts.build:post:assets: bash -c 'for d in ../../target/bundles/*/Contents/Resources; do mkdir -p "$d/ui" && cp -R webview/dist/* "$d/ui/"; done' && bun run repair:au2
scripts.package:installer: bun run package:installer:macos && bun run package:installer:windows && bun run package:installer:linux
